action: Rin skids her bike to a stop at a flooded crosswalk at midnight and pulls a small package from her bag; the package glows soft gold through its brown paper
Close on Rin's face lit gold from below as she reads the package label; her amber eyes widen in shock
Rin stands small in the middle of the empty street looking up as every neon sign in the city flickers and goes dark, block by block
Rin races her bike through the pitch-dark rainy streets, the only light is the gold glow from her messenger bag lighting the rain around her
On a rooftop in the rain, Rin kneels and opens the package; warm golden light pours out over her face and the falling raindrops
Rin stands at the rooftop edge holding the glowing light in her hands and smiles as the whole city skyline lights back up behind her
